expectations.text: Output contains all five platform sections: YouTube Description, LinkedIn Post, Instagram Caption, TikTok Caption, and Twitter/X
expectations.evidence: All five sections present with ━━━ dividers: YOUTUBE DESCRIPTION, LINKEDIN POST, INSTAGRAM CAPTION, TIKTOK CAPTION, TWITTER / X

expectations.text: LinkedIn post is between 150 and 250 words
expectations.evidence: LinkedIn post is approximately 185 words — from 'The automations saving my clients 10–15 hours...' to '...see exactly how it's set up.' Well within range.

expectations.text: Twitter/X post is under 280 characters (or clearly structured as a numbered thread)
expectations.evidence: Structured as a 3-tweet thread labeled 1/, 2/, 3/ — each individual tweet is well under 280 characters.

expectations.text: TikTok caption is under 150 characters (excluding hashtags and sound suggestion)
expectations.evidence: 'You don't need to boil the ocean. You just need to drain the puddle in front of you. 4 nodes. 25 mins. 3 hrs saved daily.' = ~122 characters.

expectations.text: At least 3 niche hashtags from the approved list appear across the outputs (e.g., #AIAutomation, #AutomationNation, #WorkSmarter, #Productivity, #AITools)
expectations.evidence: Outputs contain #AIAutomation, #BusinessAutomation, #Productivity, #WorkSmarter, #FutureOfWork, #AutomationNation, #AITools, #AIForBusiness, #SalesAI, #GTM — all from the approved list.

expectations.text: No hard-sell language appears (no 'buy now', 'limited time', 'don't miss out')
expectations.evidence: No hard-sell language found. CTAs are soft: 'Full video in the comments', 'Link in bio for the full breakdown', 'Like and subscribe'.

expectations.text: YouTube description includes at least one timestamp reference
expectations.evidence: YouTube description includes 6 timestamps: 00:00, 00:45, 01:20, 02:00, 02:30, 02:55 with descriptive labels.

expectations.text: Each platform section has a distinct hook — not identical opening lines reused across platforms
expectations.evidence: YouTube: 'The most powerful AI automations aren't the complicated ones'; LinkedIn: 'The automations saving my clients 10–15 hours a week aren't the fancy ones'; Instagram: 'A 4-node workflow. 25 minutes to build.'; TikTok: 'You don't need to boil the ocean'; Twitter: 'The automation saving my client's sales team 3 hrs/person/day?' — all distinct.
